items.title: Buddy Burton Interview, 1959-09-07
items.q: so I said all right Jimmy I'm going to go out there one Sunday with you just for curiosity and surprise Charlie

ctx.x: Bertrand was the one that caused me to go out there to visit ! man he said why don't come in that place when I had that little band down there I said it was swinging them clasps so I said all right Jimmy I'm going to go out there one Sunday with you just for curiosity and surprise Charlie and it was a surprise when I went out there see him and so all the boys just fell in love with me and
